title: Autoencoder
description: Unsupervised neural network projecting inputs through a low-dimensional bottleneck layer.
name: Autoencoder
summary: Autoencoders are feedforward neural networks trained to reconstruct their input. By introducing a lower-dimensional bottleneck layer (latent space), they force the model to learn compressed feature representations.
use_when: Learning non-linear low-dimensional data representations, denoising features, or detecting anomalies.
avoid_when: Strict linear interpretations of dimensions are required, or datasets are extremely small.
pros: Can capture highly non-linear feature interactions.
Flexible structures support convolutional, recurrent, or dense designs.
Can reconstruct clean signals from noisy inputs.
cons: Vulnerable to learning identity mappings if bottleneck size is not optimized.
Latent variables lack geometric interpretation compared to linear projections.
High computational training cost compared to linear statistical methods.

key_hyperparams.name: latent_dim
key_hyperparams.note: Dimensionality of the bottleneck representation. Balances compression and reconstruction error.
